single.rationale: GLAD is a BDC with structural headwinds including declining net income (FY25: $57.2M vs FY24: $94.5M), high fee burden (10.65% of net assets), three non-accrual loans, elevated interest rate sensitivity (86.9% floating rate portfolio facing compression from rate cuts), intense competition in middle-market lending, and substantial dilution (4% share count growth). The low P/E of 7.66x reflects these risks rather than opportunity.
